title: What came between Kingdom of Pajang and Yogyakarta Sultanate?
question: What came between Kingdom of Pajang and Yogyakarta Sultanate?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Kingdom of Pajang (1568) to Yogyakarta Sultanate (1755): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
